Title: Someone suddenly dizzy and off-balance? BE FAST stroke signs to check

Description:
The person having a stroke often can't tell something's wrong themselves - that's why BE FAST is built for the people around them. About 1 in 5 strokes affects the back of the brain, and dizziness is often the first sign anyone notices.

Balance loss, facial drooping, arm weakness, or slurred speech alongside dizziness means it's time to call 911, not wait it out. Here's how to check.
